messages:
maria: FYI I opened a TF change for the gpu nodepool module that adds zonal capacity reservations + a small taint/toleration fix. can somebody sanity-check before I run plan in staging? PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345

kevin: Seen the PR. Quick q: is the reservation modeled per-zone or per-instance-family? var name `zonal_reservations` is a bit vague.

maria: it's per-zone. I'm using a map(zone => count) so you can say us-west1-a:3, us-west1-b:3 etc. default is {} so no-op if not set.

ajay: Two quick concerns: 1) cluster-autoscaler flags — if we reserve capacity, autoscaler might try to rebalance. Do we need to tweak `--balance-similar-node-groups`? 2) The kube toleration in the GPU daemonset looked wrong: PR had toleration key `gpu` but the daemonset used operator "Exists" in some clusters. should be Equal + value 'true' to match the taint.

maria: good catch. my snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      tolerations:
        - key: "gpu"
          operator: "Equal"
          value: "true"
          effect: "NoSchedule"
```
I changed the TF module to set the taint as `gpu=true:NoSchedule` on node template.

sylvia: Terraform side: we need to attach capacity reservation id to the instance template (GCP) or capacity_reservation_spec (AWS). The module currently tries to be cloud-agnostic but we should add a provider-specific hook instead of embedding provider logic in the main module. Otherwise we'll leak GCP-only attrs into AWS runs.

dan: Also note the instance-profile secret used by the gpu-init systemd unit is referenced as a local file in the PR (`../secrets/prod/gpu-init.key`). That won't work in CI/terragrunt. We should source it from SOPS or from a terraform var populated by CI secrets.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: change detected in module `module.gpu_nodepool` — this will trigger rolling replace of node group. Estimated disruption per AZ: ~4m (drain + kubelet restart).

kevin: :thumbsup: on the toleration fix. Another nit: for pods we usually set annotation `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict=false` on long-running pinned workloads. If we don't, autoscaler could evict them into preemptible/spot churn.

ajay: pushed a tiny commit to the PR: fixes toleration, adds annotation example, and adds a note to terraform.md about capacity reservation mapping. also switched spot fallback policy in the nodepool config to `prefer-dedicated` for training jobs so preemptions are avoided by default.

maria: thanks. can someone run a plan in staging (us-west1-b) and validate autoscaler behavior with a small synthetic job? i'll queue terragrunt plan now.

sylvia: i'll run kubeconform on the rendered manifest after plan. i'll also create a sealedsecret in cluster-test for the instance-profile so CI can apply the kubelet unit.

dan: FYI finance will want SKU + reservation tags for forecasting if we turn on capacity reservations. tagging: "reserve:gpu" and SKU label are needed. @finance heads-up.

maria: plan queued. if plan looks good and infra-sanity passes i'll merge. @kevin can you LGTM the TF part?

kevin: i'll review in ~30m. left one tiny comment about variable naming (`zonal_reservations` -> `zone_capacity_reservations`) but it's bikeshedding. otherwise looks ok.

maria: perfect. i'll hold merge until both plan + LGTM. thanks all :rocket:
